title: Canonical coefficient-sized comparison constructions
statement: The coefficient-sized etale-to-pro-etale inclusion of [def-weil-pbc-site-comparison-morphism] carries the canonical constant-section ring map, its intrinsic module inverse image, and its termwise complex inverse image. These are exactly the three existing named constructions, relocated without changing their types or bodies.

source.place: part (1); local/classical detail for the finite stratification arguments

proof.text: Construct the constant-section map by the constant-sheaf adjunction, take its intrinsic module pullback, and apply that functor termwise after deriving zero preservation from its left adjunction. All three existing construction bodies are retained verbatim.

proof_origin.place: part (1); local/classical detail for the finite stratification arguments
